name: Undying Desire
source:
Laura Karnstein finds herself an orphan after her father dies. Only a fortnight later she finds out that her distant cousin, Gabriel Fionguala, is the last male heir to the Karnstein estate. She travels to Ireland to meet her cousins – including Gabriel's sister, Elsie – and finalize the paperwork. But when she arrives at the Castle of Fionguala, she finds a ruined house...

[From [url=https://jaredchansen.itch.io/undying-desire]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
父亲去世后，劳拉·卡恩斯坦发现自己成了孤儿。仅仅两周后，她发现她的远房表弟加布里埃尔·菲翁瓜拉是卡恩斯坦庄园的最后一位男性继承人。她前往爱尔兰会见她的表兄弟——包括加布里埃尔的妹妹埃尔西——并完成文书工作。但当她到达菲翁瓜拉城堡时，她发现了一座被毁的房子……

[来自[url=https://jaredchansen.itch.io/undying-desire]Itch.io[/url]]
